rows.corpus_definition: Not wanting to change your opinion or follow advice.
rows.example_en: He is too stubborn to admit he was wrong.

rows.corpus_definition: To trip and nearly fall while walking.
rows.example_en: I did stumble on the uneven sidewalk.

rows.corpus_definition: A ship that can travel under the water.
rows.example_en: The submarine dived deep into the dark ocean.

rows.corpus_definition: A regular payment to keep getting a service or product.
rows.example_en: I have a yearly subscription for this magazine.

rows.corpus_definition: To experience physical or mental pain.
rows.example_en: He continues to suffer from chronic back problems.

rows.corpus_definition: the highest point of a mountain or an important meeting of leaders
rows.example_en: They finally reached the summit after two days of climbing.

rows.corpus_definition: A medical procedure where a doctor cuts into the body to fix something.
rows.example_en: He will need surgery to fix his broken arm.

rows.corpus_definition: To stop fighting and admit defeat.
rows.example_en: The army decided to surrender the city.

rows.corpus_definition: to keep something going or at the same level over time
rows.example_en: It is hard to sustain motivation throughout the whole project.

rows.corpus_definition: An area of land that is very wet and muddy.
rows.example_en: The explorers walked carefully through the deep swamp.
